title: message_query_response: 'total' field absent when server does not return calculateTotal
description: In load_messages_for_chat, total_on_server falls back to ids.len() if the 'total' field is absent. The request sends calculateTotal:true. If kithd does not support calculateTotal, it may omit 'total' from the response. In that case total_on_server == ids.len() and the truncation notice is never shown. This is the intended fallback behavior but there is no test for the case where total is absent with ids.len()==500 (the limit). If the server returns exactly 500 IDs without total, the user sees no truncation warning even though older messages may exist. The fix would be to show a notice when ids.len() == 500 regardless of total. Minor correctness gap, not a crash.
